question: What weekly allowance, as a number, does a signed-in free Antigravity account have for each model group (Gemini models; Claude and GPT models)?
why: The plans, pricing, models and usage pages publish no number (read 2026-11-03). The CLI /usage panel shows one weekly bar as a percentage per group, with no request or token count. Third-party figures differ by more than ten times (5 requests, 5 percent of the Gemini weekly quota for one task, 57 minutes of agent time) and each rests on one account. A number needs a signed-in free account that runs `agy -p /usage --output-format json` before and after a fixed workload, which is behind a sign-up. After the removal of Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-OSS-120b that the models page announces, the free plan may keep no Claude and GPT group; a signed-in read would show that too.
